title: Concept: Subversion .svn/entries file served
description: The entries file names the repository and records the working-copy revision, which tells the caller which code revision is deployed. Because the directory is served at all, the rest of the metadata usually is too.
applicability: Responses from a deployment that was checked out instead of exported.
risk: The caller learns the repository host and the deployed revision, and can request the other administrative files to reconstruct the source.
